finite_candidate_filter: only finite E,P and positive T; never filter by magnitude, scatter or eligibility
missing_window: light-grey N/A; no invented value, no mean imputation and no fallback except the frozen Hailo Random Pattern policy
quality_note_marker: small corner dot; no full-cell hatching
axis_units: human-readable seconds, milliseconds, kS/s and MS/s; no exponential notation
llm: new NPY-derived envelope results in paper views; legacy/new provenance debate remains audit-only
hailo_random_pattern: historical explicit window in paper-selected figures
all_candidates: all finite f=0.5 candidates remain in detailed tables and individual figures; no result-dependent exclusion
duration_standard_box: Joris 1.5-IQR whiskers, showfliers=False; all values used in quartiles
duration_full_range_companion: whiskers min/max, all observed extrema visible
samplerate_box: whiskers min/max; all native rate labels; no simulated points invented
cross_sensor: same record_id within source series; own windows, not synchronized instrument error
threshold_criterion: empirical q95 absolute per-run deviation from fixed reference median
threshold_persistence: all subsequent observed settings; >=2 levels; n>=2 per group
controlled_rate_evidence: two complementary GEMM-FP16 sessions included as a separate diagnostic figure; no retroactive correction
summary_pooling: no pooling physical repetitions across workloads or source roots
summary_colour: based on user-supplied colour PSD examples; no claim of original PSD style source
future_gpu: requires an updated offline-result snapshot; rerunning this frozen package alone does not discover new raw measurements
